title: Voyage totals for the slave trades are not copied here
summary: The Slave Voyages site responded, but its about-page text did not load, so no number is stored.
body: A public database of trans-Atlantic slave-trade voyages is published at slavevoyages.org. The about page returned almost no readable text to this fetcher, so no embarked total, no mortality rate, and no comparison with the trans-Saharan or Indian Ocean trades is stored. Those comparisons matter, because a history that mentions only one route is incomplete, and the numbers are estimates with methods. Leave the quantities unsourced until the database's own documentation is read. Do not invent a total.
